info.title: SkinSync API
info.description: Evidence-aware skincare decision support. Not a medical device; no diagnosis.

delete.description: FR-20 / US-010: re-authenticate, then delete every personal row and every stored image.

post.description: SC-04: pairwise compatibility, duplicated actives/ingredients, missing data. Missing data is never 'clear'.

delete.description: Removes the analysis, observations, recommendations, original image and its upload row.

post.description:
Confirm or correct one normalisation (US-003). Produces a new, current formulation version so
results computed on the old mapping stay reproducible and are marked outdated.
Load the reviewed YAML in knowledge/ as a new DRAFT version. Fixture files are refused.

CompatibilityStatus.description: The five controlled result categories (SkinIQ spec §34).
CompatibilityStatus.title: CompatibilityStatus

ConfidenceLevel.description:
How certain the system is about an identification or result.

Distinct from EvidenceStrength (spec principle 1.2.3).
ConfidenceLevel.title: ConfidenceLevel

EvidenceStrength.description: Strength of the scientific support for a claim. NOT model confidence.
EvidenceStrength.title: EvidenceStrength

medical_boundary.default: These are estimates of visible cosmetic features based on one photo. Lighting, camera quality, makeup, filters and angle all affect them. This is not a medical diagnosis and offers no treatment. For persistent or concerning skin issues, consult a qualified professional.
medical_boundary.title: Medical Boundary
